_about: Field overrides for works that genuinely span fields (KG phase 2, 2026-10-15). `fields` replaces the catalog field list for every unit of the work (first = primary field, used as the bridge source field); `units` adds fields to the matching units only (fnmatch patterns on the unit id). A work listed under several fields in canon/catalog.json gets all of them automatically, even without an entry here. `checked_single_field` records works that were checked and kept in one field. Reasons cite the catalog (`canon/<field>.md`: why / strand / focus) and the digests.

mackay-2003-information.reason: Catalog lists it under information-theory (core) and bayesian (deep); its why: 'unites information theory with Bayesian inference and machine learning'. All 49 digests carry fields [information-theory, bayesian].

units.reason: Part V, neural networks (chs. 38-44): machine learning, which this canon keeps in the llm field (textbook strand, prince-2023-udl).
Ch. 36 Decision Theory: expected utility, value of information (decision-game-theory spine).
Ch. 31 Ising models: statistical physics, phase transitions (complex-systems criticality strand).

jaynes-2003-probability.reason: Catalog lists it under bayesian (core: 'probability as extended logic') and information-theory (reference: the entropy principle). Bayesian is primary because it is core there. All 30 digests carry fields [information-theory, bayesian].

murphy-2023-pml2.reason: Catalog (bayesian, Computation strand) why: 'connecting Bayesian inference to machine learning'; chapters on other fields' topics get those fields.

units.reason: Ch. 5 Information theory (KL divergence, entropy, mutual information).
Deep neural networks, deep generative models, representation learning and interpretability: machine learning, kept in the llm field in this canon.
Gaussian (Kalman) filtering and smoothing, state-space models, reinforcement learning: control-theory strands (state space & estimation; RL as control).

ashby-1956-cybernetics.reason: Catalog: control-theory (Feedback & cybernetics). Part Two (Variety) measures variety in bits and treats transmission, noise and channel capacity.

units.reason: Chs. 7-9: variety in bits, channel capacity, entropy, equivocation (the digests' concept lists).

sarkka-2023-bayesianfiltering.reason: Catalog (control-theory, State space & estimation) why: 'Rebuilds the Kalman filter from Bayes' rule: filtering is just recursive Bayesian updating of a belief about a hidden state'.

kelly-1956-information.reason: Catalog (economics-finance, Finance theory) why: the gambler's growth rate 'equal to Shannon's information rate of the channel'. The information-theory canon lists 'Kelly's gambler with a private wire' as a canonical instance (it names the work as kelly-1956-new).

rosvall-2008-maps.reason: Catalog (information-theory, Algorithmic information and MDL) why: the map equation 'finds network communities' by minimising description length; network community structure is in the complex-systems networks strand.

markowitz-1952-portfolio.reason: Catalog why: 'Diversification falls out of the covariance matrix ... This is the linear-algebra core of all modern portfolio theory'.

wlezien-1995-thermostat.reason: Catalog (control-theory, Control in biology, cognition & society): models public opinion and spending policy as a thermostat; public opinion is a political-science strand.

taylor-1993-discretion.reason: Catalog (control-theory, Control in biology, cognition & society): the Taylor rule for the interest rate, i.e. monetary policy.

simon-1955-behavioral.reason: Catalog (decision-game-theory, Behavioral decision & bounded rationality); the economics-finance spine has 'bounded rationality / heuristics', the concept this paper introduces.

kahneman-1979-prospect.reason: Catalog (decision-game-theory): prospect theory; the economics-finance spine has 'mental accounting, endowment effect, loss aversion' and behavioral economics builds on this paper.

chong-2007-framing.reason: Catalog (political-science): the standard political-science review of framing effects; framing is a communication-theory media-effects strand (CHARTER §3).

gelman-2013-philosophy.reason: Catalog (bayesian, Debates) why: Bayesian practice is 'hypothetico-deductive' model checking, argued against inductive belief updating: philosophy of science.

mikolov-2013-regularities.reason: Catalog (linear-algebra): word vectors encode relations as offsets; companion of the llm canon's word2vec papers (mikolov-2013-efficient, mikolov-2013-compositionality; Prehistory strand).

deerwester-1990-lsa.reason: Catalog (linear-algebra) why: truncated SVD puts words and documents in one semantic space; this is the prehistory of word embeddings (llm Prehistory strand).

kosinski-2024-llm-tom.reason: Catalog strand 'The LLM theory-of-mind debate' (CHARTER §3, theory of mind (d)): tests GPT models on false-belief tasks.

shapira-2024-clever-hans.reason: Catalog strand 'The LLM theory-of-mind debate': stress-tests LLMs on ToM tasks.

strachan-2024-llm-humans.reason: Catalog strand 'The LLM theory-of-mind debate': human vs LLM ToM battery.

ullman-2023-trivial-alterations.reason: Catalog strand 'The LLM theory-of-mind debate': small vignette changes flip LLM answers.

checked_single_field.pearl-2009-causality: bayesian only: causal inference is a strand of the Bayesian field (CHARTER §3).
checked_single_field.pearl-2018-bookofwhy: bayesian only: causal inference strand; its philosophy of causation is popular framing, not a philosophy text.
checked_single_field.sutton-2018-rl: control-theory only: reinforcement learning as control is a control-theory strand (CHARTER §3); no LLM content in the digested chapters.
checked_single_field.bertsekas-2026-rlcourse: control-theory only: RL as control strand.
checked_single_field.jaynes-1957-information: information-theory only: maximum entropy is in the information-theory scope (CHARTER §3).
checked_single_field.prince-2023-udl: llm only: the llm canon's textbook strand.
checked_single_field.deisenroth-2020-mml: linear-algebra only: the catalog places it in the numerical/ML strand of linear algebra.
checked_single_field.wiener-1948-cybernetics: not digested yet; the catalog lists it under control-theory and communication-theory, so it will get both automatically.
checked_single_field.spielman-2025-sagt: linear-algebra only: spectral graph theory is a linear-algebra application (CHARTER §3).
checked_single_field.frank-2012-rsa: theory-of-mind only: RSA is named in the computational ToM strand (CHARTER §3).
checked_single_field.argyle-2023-silicon: llm only: 'LLMs and social science' strand.
